name: io.github.lightsmite/popa-recon-mcp
title: POPA Recon MCP Server
description: Zero-auth Streamable HTTP MCP server for cited Web3, token risk, and on-chain deep research.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Reports how many free research questions are left today, the credits and the plan of the account the calls are charged to, the products on sale and the address to buy more. It starts no research and costs nothing.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Researches a factual question about a public web3 project, protocol, token, wallet, transaction or market event, in the language of the question. Starts a saved POPA Recon research request and returns the finished answer with cited sources, or a pending receipt; the research card follows a pending request live and shows the finished answer, and the answer tool reads the receipt when no card is shown. It covers research only: it gives no buy or sell advice or price predictions and makes no trades or transfers.

question.description: The question to research, in the user's language. It is researched on its own, without the chat history, so it states the project, token, address or event that any «it», «they» or «that one» refers to.
question.title: Question

tools.name: answer
tools.description: Reads the research request named by the opaque request_id that research returned. Returns pending while research runs, or the finished POPA Recon answer and its cited source links. It does not start research.
